> /tmp/hivex-vhs --help
hivebot vdev — the terminal office you always wanted.

Usage:
  hivex              Launch multi-bot team (web UI on :7891)
  hivex --legacy-tui  Launch with legacy tmux TUI instead
  hivex init         Install the latest CLI and save setup defaults
  hivex upgrade      Check npm for a newer version and show the changelog
  hivex shred        Burn the workspace down and reopen onboarding
  hivex import --from legacy  Import from a running external orchestrator (auto-detect)
  hivex log          Show what your bots actually did (task receipts)
  hivex share        Invite one team member over a private network
  hivex memory migrate --from {hive,gbrain}  Port legacy memory into the team wiki
  hivex workspace ...  Manage multiple isolated hivebot workspaces
  hivex skills publish <slug-or-path> --to <hub>    Publish a team skill to a public hub
  hivex skills install <name> --from <hub>  Pull a public skill into the team wiki
  hivex --cmd <cmd>  Run a command non-interactively

Flags:
  --1o1
        Launch a direct 1:1 session with a single bot (default cos)
  --api-key
        API key for authentication
  --blueprint
        Operation blueprint ID for this run
  --broker-port
        Port for the local broker (default 7890)
  --cmd
        Run a command non-interactively
  --collab
        Start in collaborative mode (all bots see all messages)
  --format
        Output format (text, json) (default "text")
  --from-scratch
        Start without a saved blueprint and synthesize the first operation from the directive
  --legacy-tui
        Launch with legacy tmux TUI instead of the web UI (deprecated; slated for removal)
  --memory-backend
        Memory backend for organizational context (hive, gbrain, none)
  --no-hive
        Disable Hive completely for this run
  --no-open
        Don't open browser automatically on launch
  --opus-ceo
        Upgrade CEO bot from Sonnet to Opus
  --pack
        Operation blueprint ID (legacy pack alias supported)
  --provider
